title: Color Guess
description: Choose the circle that matches the displayed RGB color and test your eye for color.
about:
Color Guess is a browser game where you read the RGB value and pick the matching colored circle. Use Change colors to get a fresh set.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Read the RGB value and pick the matching colored circle. Use Change colors to get a fresh set.
tips: Use click / tap a circle to guess the matching color.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Color Guess?
faq.answer: Read the RGB value and pick the matching colored circle. Use Change colors to get a fresh set.

faq.question: Can I play Color Guess in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.

author: Raphael Martins
